chip.description: CMOS 6502 successor with additional instructions and addressing modes, developed by the Western Design Center (W65C02) and produced by several licensees.
chip.notes: Deliberate manufacturer/family mismatch: the m6502 family description itself names WDC among the second sources. This row is the base 65C02 line; r65c02 is Rockwell's licensed variant with additional bit-manipulation instructions.
